nom: Curology Gentle Face Wash for Sensitive Skin

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive, often acne-prone skin report the cleanser is gentle and does not strip, dry out or irritate their skin, including one who ended harsh breakouts that had lasted since age 12; one of these reviewers notes it doesn't clear closed comedones, so results have limits.
segments.oily: The one reviewer who names partly oily skin reports it works well for her, though she found the texture thicker and richer than the 'lightly foaming' name suggested.
segments.normal: One reviewer with sensitive, acne-prone skin herself suggests this cleanser is best suited to people with normal, non-acne-prone skin looking for a simple, no-fuss wash.

concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several who call their skin acne-prone, report the cleanser does not cause breakouts and helps keep existing acne under control, in one case ending harsh breakouts that had lasted since age 12; several add an important limitation, though, saying it doesn't fully clear their acne or closed comedones, and breakouts can return quickly if they skip a wash.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently report the cleanser does not leave skin feeling stripped, tight or dry after washing, including some with sensitive or acne-prone skin who say typical gentle cleansers still feel drying to them.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer specifically credits the formula with helping maintain a healthy skin barrier, since it cleanses without stripping moisture.
concerns.oiliness: The two reviewers who mention oiliness both report a balanced result: the cleanser doesn't leave skin feeling oily, and it works well on partly oily skin, though one found the actual texture thicker than she expected from a 'lightly foaming' product.

aspects.libelle: Pump or cap frequently arrives broken, missing or unusable
Creamy, lightly foaming texture, less lather than the name implies
Marketed fragrance-free, though a couple detect a faint scent
Doesn't fully remove makeup on its own
Good value, one bottle lasts about a month with daily use
A hidden plastic ring under the pump cap is easy to miss

extraits.texte: love this product, i’ve reordered about 5 times so far but it does not fully resolve very acne prone skin. i’ve only received it one time with an actual working pump. today i finally got a pump except they just threw it into the box. again, i will be reusing the same pump i’ve had since my first purchase. for the price, there should be at least a working pump!

extraits.titre: I wish it did just a little bit more -
extraits.texte: I have really sensitive acne prone skin. Most of the gentle/simple cleaners on the market like Cetaphil and Cerave don't work for me at all. This one feels very comparable to texture and smell of those basic cleansers (fragrance free), however, it doesn't irritate my skin whatsoever. I use it as the second step in my double cleanser routine and it does the job without making my face feel like it's stripped of moisture. 4/5 starts because it's not a holy-grail type of product for me. I wish it cleared closed comedones, but it doesn't do that. It's a really simple-feeling cleaner. If you have normal, non-acne prone skin, you'll most likely love this no-fuss cleaner.

I've been using Curology for a while now, and it's become a staple in my skincare routine. One of the standout features is how clean my face feels after each use. Unlike many other cleansers, it doesn't leave my skin feeling stripped of moisture, which is crucial for maintaining a healthy skin barrier. The cleanser has a modest lather – not too much, but just enough to feel effective. This balanced formulation is perfect for my sensitive skin, as it cleanses thoroughly without causing irritation or dryness. It is also a great size, which last me at least a month, even with consistent use (at least once a day, sometimes twice). The smell is very mild, I don’t believe they add any fragrance so I don’t really notice any smell at all. The texture is light. I don’t really notice any ‘foaming’ as this name implies, just a really light lather. I also don’t use any tools to wash my face, just my hands. You might get some foam if you use a sponge/brush/cloth. I also recommend pairing it with the moisturizer from the same brand (the gel one - I never used the cream one). Together, they create a skincare combo that I don't see myself changing anytime soon. If you have sensitive skin and are looking for a gentle yet effective cleanser, I highly recommend.

Curology Gentle Facial Cleanser has been a game changer for my sensitive skin. I have dealt with acne since I was 12 years old and I am now 48. This by far has been the best thing for my skin. No embarrassing harsh breakouts anymore! My complexion looks better and my T-zone on my face is clear. With Acne products, you basically have to do trial and error. What works for someone else may not work for you. This formula is gentle on the skin and you will start to see results within the 1st week of use. I finally found a product that truly works well with my skin. I am so Grateful. I highly recommend and I will continue to purchase.

I’ve been using this cleanser for a while now, and it has made a huge difference in my skin. My acne hasn’t cleared up 100%, but it’s definitely improved compared to where I started. I can really tell it’s working because if I get lazy and skip washing my face for a day or two, my breakouts start coming back almost immediately. The cleanser is gentle, doesn’t leave my face feeling tight or dry, and does a great job of cleaning my skin without irritation. Since my acne isn’t completely gone, I think I’m going to try Curology’s acne cleanser next to see if that gives me the extra boost I need. Also, do yourself a favor and get the matching moisturizer! It’s amazing. It keeps my skin hydrated without feeling greasy, and the cleanser and moisturizer work so well together. Overall, I’d definitely recommend this cleanser if you’re looking for something gentle that helps improve acne while keeping your skin healthy. I’ll continue using Curology because it’s been one of the best skincare brands I’ve tried.

I’ve been using Curology’s cleanser for about 7 years now and it’s the only one that doesn’t irritate my skin and keeps my skin clear and healthy. It doesn’t dry it out or leave it feeling oily. A go-to for me!

This review is for Curology Gentle Cleanser, Lightly Foaming Gel Face Wash, Sensitive Skin Care, Fragrance Free, 5.07 fl oz. Nice gentle face wash. Easy to apply and wash off. I thought it would be more foaming and light (vs lightly foaming) but it was thicker than what I had expected. It’s nice though and feels rich and smooth. Even though it is supposed to be fragrance free, I thought it still had a light fragrance to it which I actually kind of like. I like the bottle and it looks nice. I like how the pump is protected by a removable clip to prevent accidental presses while in transit. Overall, a very nice lightly foaming gel face wash and works great on my partly oily skin. I’d give it a 4.8/5.0 - 01/02/2024.
